name: Spam Comment Remover
author: sahildadwal

sections.description:
Spam Comment Remover is a lightweight WordPress plugin that:

  • Automatically deletes spam comments before they are saved
  • Cleans all existing spam and pending comments after activation
  • Blocks spam with:
    • Fake names
    • Links or emails
    • Gibberish content
    • Non-English characters (Cyrillic, Chinese, Arabic, etc.)
  • Removes the “Website” field from the comment form
  • Stops bots using temporary or fake email addresses
  • Works silently – no settings needed
  • Adds an admin notice after activation to remind you to clear your cache

☕ Support the developer: https://ko-fi.com/sahildadwal
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/spam-comment-remover directory, or install it via WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Done! Spam detection starts immediately.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require Akismet or other services?

  • No. It works independently using built-in detection logic.

Will it delete old spam and pending comments too?

  • Yes. As soon as you activate the plugin, all spam and pending comments are deleted automatically.

Can I restore deleted comments?

  • No. Deleted comments are permanently removed.

Does this block non-English comments?

  • Yes, it blocks spammy content in foreign scripts like Cyrillic, Chinese, and Arabic.
